alt: France's Kylian Mbappé stretching to reach the ball on the bright green Bermuda grass pitch at MetLife Stadium during the France vs Senegal World Cup Group I match on 16 June 2026
story: After seven years of engineering research, FIFA installed Tahoma 31 Bermudagrass at MetLife Stadium — the World Cup Final venue — but France coach Deschamps said it 'might be cement below the grass,' midfielder Rabiot called it 'more like an artificial surface,' and Brazil's Vinicius said it dries out so fast the ball slows mid-game.
why_funny: Seven years and millions of dollars of sports-science turf research produced a field the world's best players refuse to wear studs on.
